eevee-last-resort.name: Last Resort
eevee-last-resort.description: Bond skill: its trump card, an all-out tackle (Power 100, Attack).

eevee-hyper-voice.name: Hyper Voice
eevee-hyper-voice.description: Bond skill: a piercing cry up to 2 hexes away (Power 75) hitting a 1-hex area.

eevee-extreme-speed.name: Extreme Speed
eevee-extreme-speed.description: Bond skill: a blurring dash up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 60) that engages it.

eevee-run-away.name: Run Away
eevee-run-away.description: Steps away from engaged foes without free strikes; deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes.

eevee-adaptability.name: Adaptability
eevee-adaptability.description: Its Normal moves deal 20% more damage.

eevee-covet.name: Covet
eevee-covet.description: New skill: a cute lunge (Power 60); a knockout with it gives the team 1 Bond.

eevee-anticipation.name: Anticipation
eevee-anticipation.description: Senses danger coming: takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

eevee-pack-friend.name: Pack Friend
eevee-pack-friend.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with its allies.

eevee-swift.name: Swift
eevee-swift.description: New skill: stars that never miss a foe up to 2 hexes away, even around others (Power 60).

eevee-take-down.name: Take Down
eevee-take-down.description: New skill: a reckless body slam (Power 75) that knocks the foe back 1 hex.

eevee-wish.name: Wish
eevee-wish.description: New skill: makes a wish that heals itself or an ally up to 2 hexes away by 30 HP.

eevee-eviolite.name: Eviolite
eevee-eviolite.description: Full of untapped potential: takes 15% less damage.

eevee-spirited.name: Spirited
eevee-spirited.description: Each knockout it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

eevee-double-edge.name: Double-Edge
eevee-double-edge.description: New skill: a life-risking tackle with everything it has (Power 90).

eevee-endure.name: Endure
eevee-endure.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

eevee-second-wind.name: Second Wind
eevee-second-wind.description: Heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

eevee-giga-impact.name: Giga Impact
eevee-giga-impact.description: New skill: charges with its whole body (Power 100) and knocks the foe back 1 hex.

eevee-tri-attack.name: Tri Attack
eevee-tri-attack.description: New skill: three linked beams at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80).

eevee-cheerful.name: Cheerful
eevee-cheerful.description: Each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

eevee-stubborn.name: Stubborn
eevee-stubborn.description: Deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

eevee-untapped-potential.name: Untapped Potential
eevee-untapped-potential.description: Capstone. Deals 10% more damage; gains 1 Attack for the battle per knockout (max +3).

eevee-adaptable-spirit.name: Adaptable Spirit
eevee-adaptable-spirit.description: Capstone. Immune to all statuses and heals 3% of max HP each turn.

eevee-hydration.name: Hydration
eevee-hydration.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

eevee-water-veil.name: Water Veil
eevee-water-veil.description: A veil of water covers its body: it cannot be Burned.

eevee-surf.name: Surf
eevee-surf.description: New skill: a wave crashing up to 1 hex away (Power 85) hitting a 1-hex area.

eevee-aqua-tail.name: Aqua Tail
eevee-aqua-tail.description: New skill: lashes with its finned tail like a crashing wave (Power 85).

eevee-melt-away.name: Melt Away
eevee-melt-away.description: Its cells melt into the water around it: takes 10% less damage.

eevee-deep-current.name: Deep Current
eevee-deep-current.description: Its Water moves deal 15% more damage.

eevee-muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
eevee-muddy-water.description: New skill: a muddy surge up to 1 hex away (Power 90, 1-hex area) that Slows for 1 turn.

eevee-acid-armor.name: Acid Armor
eevee-acid-armor.description: New skill: liquefies its body: Fortified for 3 turns.

eevee-undertow.name: Undertow
eevee-undertow.description: Foes it engages take 15% more damage from its allies.

eevee-rising-tide.name: Rising Tide
eevee-rising-tide.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

eevee-aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring
eevee-aqua-ring.description: Capstone. A ring of water heals it 4% of max HP each turn, 8% while engaged.

eevee-tsunami.name: Tsunami
eevee-tsunami.description: Capstone. Its ranged moves reach 1 hex farther; deals 20% more damage to Slowed foes.

eevee-quick-feet.name: Quick Feet
eevee-quick-feet.description: Gains 2 movement while it carries a status.

eevee-needle-fur.name: Needle Fur
eevee-needle-fur.description: Its bristling needles deal 6 damage to foes that hit it from an adjacent hex.

eevee-discharge.name: Discharge
eevee-discharge.description: New skill: releases electricity on all adjacent foes (Power 75), Paralyzing for 1 turn.

eevee-thunder-fang.name: Thunder Fang
eevee-thunder-fang.description: New skill: an electrified bite (Power 70) that Paralyzes the foe for 1 turn.

eevee-charge.name: Charge
eevee-charge.description: Stores electricity: its Electric moves deal 15% more damage.

eevee-hair-trigger.name: Hair Trigger
eevee-hair-trigger.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

eevee-electro-ball.name: Electro Ball
eevee-electro-ball.description: New skill: an electric orb up to 2 hexes away (Power 80); damage uses Speed.

eevee-volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
eevee-volt-switch.description: New skill: a jolt at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 70), then it slips out of engagement.

eevee-pent-up-static.name: Pent-up Static
eevee-pent-up-static.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

eevee-swift-hunter.name: Swift Hunter
eevee-swift-hunter.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

eevee-thunderstorm-mane.name: Thunderstorm Mane
eevee-thunderstorm-mane.description: Capstone. Deals 20% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away and 20% more to Paralyzed foes.

eevee-lightning-chain.name: Lightning Chain
eevee-lightning-chain.description: Capstone. A knockout resets its skill cooldowns and lets it use its basic attack again.

eevee-guts.name: Guts
eevee-guts.description: Deals 20% more damage while it carries a status.

eevee-searing-fur.name: Searing Fur
eevee-searing-fur.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Burn them for 1 turn.

eevee-flare-blitz.name: Flare Blitz
eevee-flare-blitz.description: New skill: a blazing full-body charge (Power 95).

eevee-lava-plume.name: Lava Plume
eevee-lava-plume.description: New skill: scarlet flames on all adjacent foes (Power 75), Burning for 1 turn.

eevee-inner-furnace.name: Inner Furnace
eevee-inner-furnace.description: Its Fire moves deal 25% more damage while it is below half HP.

eevee-kindled-hunt.name: Kindled Hunt
eevee-kindled-hunt.description: Deals 20% more damage to Burned foes.

eevee-overheat.name: Overheat
eevee-overheat.description: New skill: a full-power blast of fire at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 100).

eevee-ember-heart.name: Ember Heart
eevee-ember-heart.description: Heals 15% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

eevee-sunny-day.name: Sunny Day
eevee-sunny-day.description: Its inner sun blazes: its Fire moves deal 15% more damage.

eevee-last-flame.name: Last Flame
eevee-last-flame.description: Capstone. Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP; deals 20% more damage below half HP.

eevee-wildfire.name: Wildfire
eevee-wildfire.description: Capstone. Its statuses last 1 turn longer and spread to adjacent foes when the carrier faints.

eevee-heat-crash.name: Heat Crash
eevee-heat-crash.description: New skill: slams its blazing body into a foe (Power 100), knocking it back 1 hex.

eevee-tail-whip.name: Tail Whip
eevee-tail-whip.description: New skill: wags its tail cutely; adjacent foes are Marked for 2 turns.

eevee-agility.name: Agility
eevee-agility.description: New skill: relaxes and lightens its body; Hasted for 2 turns.
